article.title: The uses—and misuses—of Social Reproduction Theory
article.author: Editor
article.content: What is Social Reproduction Theory? It is a Marxist feminist term which covers how capitalism depends on unpaid care in the home for the ongoing reproduction of human life and labour. The post The uses—and misuses—of Social Reproduction Theory appeared first on MR Online .
